description: Create a countdown badge — a small image, not an

badge_style.description: Visual style: "board" (default, dark), "minimal" (no background — blends into any page) or "light".

duration.description: How long the timer runs. Accepts "25m", "1h30m", "90s", "5:00", "1:30:00", or a plain number read as minutes ("45"). A setup link or OBS overlay holds up to 99h59m59s. With start_now or embed_on_website, longer countdowns of up to 366 days are fine: "10d", "10 days", "10d 6h" or "240h".

label.description: Optional short name shown on the badge, e.g. "Launch" or "CFP closes".

name: create_badge
title: Create a countdown badge for a README, forum post or similar
